title: Print every key
prompt: The inventory is a dictionary of item names to amounts. Print each item name on its own line, in order.
hints: Looping over a dictionary gives you its keys.

docs.name: for key in data:
docs.what: Runs once per key; data[key] gives its value.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
